title: N -W F P Finance Amendment Act 1972

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Finance Amendment Act 1972
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT IV OF 1973
ACT IV OF 1973
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1972
An Act to amend
North-West Frontier Province Finance Act, 1972
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 12th January 1973]
No. Legis. 1 (43)/72.-The
following Act of the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier Province
having been assented to by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province,
on the 12th January 1973, is hereby published for general information :-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province
Finance (Amendment) Act, 1972.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
